name: MOM12-1-ALL-5-MKT
rules_text: On the first session of each month, holds up to 5 of all 108 names (taxed names must clear the tax) with the highest 12–1 momentum; keeps a name while it ranks 15th or better; no exit date. Holds cash while the equal-weight market is at or below its 200-session average (checked on the first session of each month).
